name: Overlap-Add Stereogram (OLAS)
definition: OLAS is a holographic stereogram algorithm that encodes a light field into a hologram by treating the stereogram as an inverse Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) and allowing hogel overlap. It solves the spatio-angular resolution tradeoff inherent in traditional HS methods, where increasing hogel size improves angular resolution but degrades spatial resolution.
